name: Hanaoka Mari
source:
Mari has good leadership skills and takes tennis more seriously than most of the younger players do, so she often tries to encourage them to put more effort into the Tennis Team, comprised of [url=/c98252]Azusa[/url] and [url=/c98255]Himeno[/url], and not just go at their own pace.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
